claim: On January 11, 2024 Amazon ECS added support for configuring 1 Amazon EBS data volume per task during deployment, for standalone tasks and for tasks managed by an ECS service.
question: When did ECS add Amazon EBS data volumes for tasks?

values.display: 1 Amazon EBS data volume per task

note: The ebs-volumes page says Fargate supports EBS volumes on Linux platform 1.4.0 or later (fact fargate-ebs-volumes-need-linux-platform-1-4-0). Before this date, Fargate tasks had only ephemeral storage and EFS.
